Quest name: Mysteries Lies in the Details (Chrono Quest - 2nd period, 15th Century)
Quest location: Lisbon Adventurers' Guild
Skill requirement: r9 Search, r11 Appraisal, PRT(Portuguese)
Pre-requisite quest + discovery: "Honor to Those Who Travel the Seas" + Catalan Atlas discovery (from "Looking at Foreign Lands" quest) + Carta Pisana discovery (from "Unfinished Map")
Additional notes: "Branch-off" part of Sagres (Henrique & Jose) storyline
